changes.title: REST API version 2026-03-10 is the latest; callers on the default 2022-11-28 get its breaking changes only when they move the X-GitHub-Api-Version header.

source.quote: The GitHub REST API is versioned. The API version name is based on the date when the API version was released. For example, the API version 2026-03-10 was released on Tue, 10 Mar 2026.

changes.title: REST 2026-03-10 removes the deprecated rate property from GET /rate_limit; read resources.core instead.

source.quote: The rate property has been deprecated since 2021 and duplicates information available in the resources.core property.

changes.title: REST 2026-03-10 removes the deprecated permission parameter when creating a team.

source.quote: Remove deprecated permission property from request when a team is created

changes.title: REST 2026-03-10 reports submodules as type "submodule" instead of "file" when listing directory contents.

source.quote: Updates the "Get repository content" API, so that, when listing the contents of a directory, submodules have the type "submodule" instead of the type "file"

changes.title: REST 2026-03-10 drops use_squash_pr_title_as_default from repository objects in favour of squash_merge_commit_title (every endpoint that returns a repository).

source.quote: Remove deprecated use_squash_pr_title_as_default property from repo settings endpoints This property has been replaced by squash_merge_commit_title.

changes.title: GraphQL removes CheckAnnotation.databaseId on 2027-01-01; use fullDatabaseId.

source.quote: Breaking A change will be made to CheckAnnotation.databaseId. Description: databaseId will be removed. Use fullDatabaseId instead.

changes.title: GraphQL removes Artifact.databaseId on 2027-01-01; use fullDatabaseId.

source.quote: Breaking A change will be made to Artifact.databaseId. Description: databaseId will be removed. Use fullDatabaseId instead.

changes.title: GraphQL User.viewerRelevantRepositories was removed on 2026-10-01; use viewerCopilotChatRepositorySuggestions.

source.quote: Breaking A change will be made to User.viewerRelevantRepositories. Description: viewerRelevantRepositories will be removed. Use viewerCopilotChatRepositorySuggestions instead.
